mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free returns, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals severe economic distress that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors liquidate equity positions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.025.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) during a supply shock regime signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13500 billion) reflects robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 13500 billion, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that forces the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL (YoY) > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicate a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 5.0%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% during a monetary tightening cycle signals aggressive policy normalization that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.
